\begin{equation} |2tR_{ij}(x_0, t_0) + g_{ij}|^2 \: = \: (2tR_{ij}(x_0, t_0) + g_{ij})(2tR^{ij}(x_0, t_0) + g^{ij}) \: < \: \xi ^2. \end{equation} (b) Given in addition $A < \infty $ and allowing $T$ to depend on $A$, we can ensure (45) for all points in $B(x_0, t_0, Ar \sqrt{t_0})$.
(c) The same is true for $P(x_0, t_0, Ar \sqrt{t_0}, A r^2 t_0)$.

Note that the time $T$ will depend on the initial metric.
